violation_type.title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)
violation_type.typical_finding: One out of four employee records evaluated was unavailable for review.     One out of four employee records evaluated was incomplete.

finding_variants.text: One out of four employee records evaluated was unavailable for review.     One out of four employee records evaluated was incomplete.

Two caregivers and the Directors file are incomplete.

Out of 6 personnel records reviewed, 1 staff member was missing an affidavit, 3 staff files were missing signatures on employee paperpwork, and all 6 were missing date of hire information at the time of inspection.
